label: SIMULATED — Halden Coffee Works is fictional; truth is used only to grade.

revenue.explanation: Response curves: 1000 posterior draws of MMM run mmm-halden-6a9bb005. Quarterly response per channel = 13 × weekly steady-state response at flat spend (normalised adstock; ramp-up and post-quarter carryover ignored). Objective 'New-customer revenue' = Σ incremental first-order revenue. Exact dynamic programming on a $1,000 grid maximises the posterior expected objective subject to total budget $500,000 (spend all) and per-channel limits. P10/P50/P90 are percentiles of the plan's outcome across posterior draws (these are the conservative / baseline / optimistic scenarios). Channels flagged 'outside observed range' would be spent at a weekly level never seen in the history: the curve there is an extrapolation.
